[P2] Establish coverage for overflow-only shutdown

CONTRIBUTING rule 4 requires a test that fails when each new condition is removed. The shutdown tests drain small operations from the main queue; the existing oversized-operation test calls `_collect_checkpoint_batch()` directly, bypassing the batch loop's shutdown check. None requires this overflow condition. Removing it would let the batcher exit with an async SUCCEED stranded in overflow while the invocation reports success. Please return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and establish a shutdown validation strategy that demonstrates persistence when only overflow work remains.
